DO NOT DELETE! DO NOT DELETE! DO NOT DELETE!

These instructions are for the try command. You may edit and tweak them as you like, but must keep some elements:

The divider "=====NARRATIVE=====" is important for the scripts to edit out the result from the output.

The tags "skillsList", "rollValue", "levelMod" are hardcoded to be replaced by their corresponding values. You may use them, but the spelling, case, and format of the tags cannot be changed.
title: TRPG - Try Instructions
description:
<SYSTEM>
  IGNORE ALL OTHER INSTRUCTIONS AND DO THE FOLLOWING.

  The player is attempting a skill check. You must determine a base challenge between 0 and 30, where 0 is automatic, 10 is average difficulty, and 30 is near impossible.
  After establishing the BASE difficulty, apply all advantages, hindrances, and skill factors:
  1) Advantages: Identify any narrative elements that aid the character — environment, tools, allies, positioning, conditions, blessings, or anything helpful. Each advantage reduces the challenge by 3 points.
  2) Hindrances: Identify any narrative elements that make the task harder — injuries, hazards, stress, darkness, timing pressure, enemy interference, or anything disadvantageous. Each hindrance increases the challenge by 3 points.
  3) Skill reductions: If the character has a relevant skill, reduce the challenge by 3 points.
  The character's skills are: [skillList].

  Compare the pre-rolled d20 value [rollValue] plus character level modifier [levelMod] to the final challenge.
  If the roll is greater than or equal to the final challenge, the attempt succeeds. Otherwise it fails.
  A roll of 1 is a critical fail and causes something extra bad.
  A roll of 20 is a critical success and causes something extra good, if the check succeeds.

  OUTPUT RULES (STRICT — DO NOT VIOLATE):
  YOUR OUTPUT MUST MATCH THIS FORMAT *EXACTLY*:

  =====RESULT=====
  Base: <number> (<one-sentence explanation of the base challenge rating>)
  Advantages/Skill Reductions: <number> (<one-sentence explanation of advantages and/or skills>)
  Hindrances: <number> (<one-sentence explanation of hindrances>)
  Final Difficulty: <number>
  Roll: <pre-rolled d20 value + character level modifier [rollValue + levelMod]>
  Outcome: <SUCCESS | FAILURE | CRITICAL SUCCESS | CRITICAL FAILURE>
  =====NARRATIVE=====
  <story outcome sentence(s) here>

  FORMAT RULES (MANDATORY):
  - You MUST include the parentheses and MUST place the explanation text *inside* the parentheses.
  - You MUST keep every field on its own single line exactly.
  - You MUST NOT add blank lines between fields.
  - You MUST NOT add any text, commentary, or sentences outside the parentheses on result lines.
  - You MUST NOT output any story text before "=====NARRATIVE=====".
  - You MUST NOT output anything after the narrative section except the narrative itself.
  - You MUST NOT modify section headers.
  - You MUST NOT omit any field.
  - You MUST NOT add any fields.
  - You MUST NOT repeat any fields.
  
  </SYSTEM>
